nodes.Name: PublicSuffixList
nodes.DocComment:
PublicSuffixList provides the public suffix of a domain. For example:
  - the public suffix of "example.com" is "com",
  - the public suffix of "foo1.foo2.foo3.co.uk" is "co.uk", and
  - the public suffix of "bar.pvt.k12.ma.us" is "pvt.k12.ma.us".

Implementations of PublicSuffixList must be safe for concurrent use by
multiple goroutines.

An implementation that always returns "" is valid and may be useful for
testing but it is not secure: it means that the HTTP server for foo.com can
set a cookie for bar.com.

A public suffix list implementation is in the package
golang.org/x/net/publicsuffix.

nodes.Name: Options
nodes.DocComment: Options are the options for creating a new Jar.

nodes.Name: Jar
nodes.DocComment: Jar implements the http.CookieJar interface from the net/http package.

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment:
New returns a new cookie jar. A nil [*Options] is equivalent to a zero
Options.

nodes.Name: entry
nodes.DocComment:
entry is the internal representation of a cookie.

This struct type is not used outside of this package per se, but the exported
fields are those of RFC 6265.

nodes.Name: id
nodes.DocComment: id returns the domain;path;name triple of e as an id.

nodes.Name: shouldSend
nodes.DocComment:
shouldSend determines whether e's cookie qualifies to be included in a
request to host/path. It is the caller's responsibility to check if the
cookie is expired.

nodes.Name: domainMatch
nodes.DocComment:
domainMatch checks whether e's Domain allows sending e back to host.
It differs from "domain-match" of RFC 6265 section 5.1.3 because we treat
a cookie with an IP address in the Domain always as a host cookie.

nodes.Name: pathMatch
nodes.DocComment: pathMatch implements "path-match" according to RFC 6265 section 5.1.4.

nodes.Name: hasDotSuffix
nodes.DocComment: hasDotSuffix reports whether s ends in "."+suffix.

nodes.Name: Cookies
nodes.DocComment:
Cookies implements the Cookies method of the [http.CookieJar] interface.

It returns an empty slice if the URL's scheme is not HTTP or HTTPS.

nodes.Name: cookies
nodes.DocComment: cookies is like Cookies but takes the current time as a parameter.

nodes.Name: SetCookies
nodes.DocComment:
SetCookies implements the SetCookies method of the [http.CookieJar] interface.

It does nothing if the URL's scheme is not HTTP or HTTPS.

nodes.Name: setCookies
nodes.DocComment: setCookies is like SetCookies but takes the current time as parameter.

nodes.Name: canonicalHost
nodes.DocComment:
canonicalHost strips port from host if present and returns the canonicalized
host name.

nodes.Name: hasPort
nodes.DocComment:
hasPort reports whether host contains a port number. host may be a host
name, an IPv4 or an IPv6 address.

nodes.Name: jarKey
nodes.DocComment: jarKey returns the key to use for a jar.

nodes.Name: isIP
nodes.DocComment: isIP reports whether host is an IP address.

nodes.Name: defaultPath
nodes.DocComment:
defaultPath returns the directory part of a URL's path according to
RFC 6265 section 5.1.4.

nodes.Name: newEntry
nodes.DocComment:
newEntry creates an entry from an http.Cookie c. now is the current time and
is compared to c.Expires to determine deletion of c. defPath and host are the
default-path and the canonical host name of the URL c was received from.

remove records whether the jar should delete this cookie, as it has already
expired with respect to now. In this case, e may be incomplete, but it will
be valid to call e.id (which depends on e's Name, Domain and Path).

A malformed c.Domain will result in an error.

nodes.Name: endOfTime
nodes.DocComment:
endOfTime is the time when session (non-persistent) cookies expire.
This instant is representable in most date/time formats (not just
Go's time.Time) and should be far enough in the future.

nodes.Name: domainAndType
nodes.DocComment: domainAndType determines the cookie's domain and hostOnly attribute.
